item.title: Free Weekly Download: Redeem Your Track
item.description: Virginia native Bruce Hornsby's new album, Indigo Park, comes out on April 3rd. The title track is this week's Free Weekly Download at WNRN.org. item.title: Grateful Dead and Phriends Playlist 3/28/26
item.description: Marc Smith and Ed Monde have hosted The Grateful Dead & Phriends for a long time, but love every minute of it. Marc and Ed are both diehard fans of Phish, Grateful Dead, Aquarium Rescue Unit, Umphreys McGee, Les Claypool, Widespread Panic, the Charlottesville music scene and many more. Please join the Grateful Dead and Phriends with Marc Smith and Ed Monde every Saturday from 9 a.m. – noon.

item.title: Bluegrass Sunday Morning Playlist 3/29/26
item.description: Rusty Cempre has listened to the radio every day since he was 10 years old. For more than a decade he’s brought that same passion as the host of Bluegrass Sunday Morning.

item.title: Rose's Pawn Shop In-Studio Session
item.description: Rose’s Pawn Shop released their fifth studio album last month, and joins us in the WNRN studio to perform songs from the record—live. Hear a few songs from American Seams (plus a surprise throwback) as members of Rose's Pawn Shop chat with Bob Mosolgo during an In-Studio Session Tuesday, March 31 at 5 p.m.

item.title: Encore: David Byrne on World Cafe
item.description: David Byrne is someone whose creativity seems unstoppable, but his newest album, Who is the Sky?, began with a bout of writer’s block. He’s heading back out on tour, and on the next World Cafe, David Byrne talks about his vibrant live show, about why he felt like he couldn’t create at one point, how he got through it, and about the younger generations who keep discovering his work.

item.title: Hear Together: Project GROWS Spring Open House
item.description: Project GROWS is a nonprofit dedicated to growing a healthy community by connecting all people to nutritious foods. With a 10-acre farm in Augusta County as their base, they cultivate health through local food markets, hands-on farm and nutrition education, and partnerships that strengthen the local food system.They are hosting a Spring Open House on May 1 from 4-6pm. item.title: Encore: Snail Mail Mini Concert on World Cafe
item.description: On Snail Mail’s new album, Ricochet, Lindsey Jordan wanted to get away from matters of the heart to questions about absence and death. To get you up to speed with Snail Mail’s music, we’re revisiting a session with the Baltimore band from 2022. You’ll hear a mini-concert featuring songs from her critically acclaimed album, Valentine, on the next World Cafe.

item.title: Hear Together: Hope Fest
item.description: Reclaimed Hope Initiative is a nonprofit support and advocacy organization in Charlottesville, founded to strengthen and empower families navigating foster care, adoption, and children with disabilities.They present Hope Fest, Saturday April 18th from 4-8PM. They welcome you to bring your entire family to enjoy this music festival at Rivanna River Company, for an evening of live music, local food and beverages and a kids area with bounce house, petting zoo and more.
